meaning:
1) hire, wages
1a) wages
1b) reward, pay
1c) fare, fee, passage-money

renderings.kjv: neither have they any more a reward
and it shall be the wages

renderings.bsb: and against those who defraud laborers

elsewhere.note: After these things Yahweh’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”
Pharaoh’s daughter said to her, “Take this child away, and nurse him for me, and I will give you your wages.” The woman took the child, and nursed it.
You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.
It shall not seem hard to you when you let him go free from you; for he has been double the value of a hired hand as he served you six years. Yahweh your God…
Now therefore command that cedar trees be cut for me out of Lebanon. My servants will be with your servants; and I will give you wages for your servants…
But you be strong, and don’t let your hands be slack; for your work will be rewarded.”
Behold, children are a heritage of Yahweh. The fruit of the womb is his reward.
Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.
